device.flash: 4 MB SPI (the box of dumps/STRONG PRIMA VIII/)

image.layout: a complete 4 MB flash image with the M3801 chunk chain: the bootloader chunk at 0 (1.0.0, 2009-06-18, next chunk at 0x01FE00) like the box's flash dump, newer main code, no user database

source.note: Not recorded: Strong's firmware update for the Prima VIII, the "update v1.0.6" the owner of dumps/STRONG PRIMA VIII/ says he downloaded (see that dump).  Added to this repository on 2026-01-20 ("Create SRT_Prima_VIII_V1.0.6_20160114.abs") without a note of where it was downloaded from.

simulator.note: run_dump_Prima_to_check_program.py, run_dump_Prima_to_print_success.py and run_dump_Prima_to_main_app.py boot it through the bootloader ("bl_flash_init!", "bl_verify_sw", "check_program!", "success!") into the main application.  Without a channel database it opens its first-install wizard (2026-10-13, run_dump_prima8_update_capture_screen.py): "Welcome" -- language English, region United Kingdom, subtitle off, aspect mode auto, scan mode free, connection HDMI -- drawn by ~20 GE commands (~230 M instructions) through the M3801's GE and GMA.  Its remote takes the flash dump's extended-NEC coding (ext00; under the default "nec" DOWN did nothing): DOWN / UP move the wizard's highlight, RIGHT steps a value (2026-10-14).  Unlike the dump's application it does not poll GPIO 31 / 9 for buttons on its wizard (it reads only the GPIO bank of its CH455 driver's pinless software I2C bus, GPIO 127), so it has no panel entry.

desc: Despite the .abs name it is a complete 4 MB flash image.
